definitionBean.title: Cube and Cuboid
definitionBean.definition: A cube is a solid whose all sides are equal, whereas in a cuboid, length, breadth and height can be different.
definitionBean.explanation: Total surface area of a cube = 6a², Volume = a³ (where a is side). Total surface area of a cuboid = 2(lb+bh+hl), Volume = l×b×h.
importantPoints: Cube is a special case of cuboid when l=b=h

definitionBean.title: Cylinder
definitionBean.definition: A cylinder is a solid with circular bases of equal radius at both ends connected by a curved surface.
definitionBean.explanation: Curved surface area of a cylinder = 2πrh, total surface area = 2πr(h+r), and volume = πr²h, where r is radius and h is height.

definitionBean.title: Cone
definitionBean.definition: A cone is a solid that has a circular base and tapers smoothly to a apex point.
definitionBean.explanation: Curved surface area of a cone = πrl, total surface area = πr(l+r), volume = ⅓πr²h, where l is the slant height and l² = r² + h².

definitionBean.title: Sphere and Hemisphere
definitionBean.definition: A sphere is a perfectly round three-dimensional solid, while a hemisphere is half of a sphere.
definitionBean.explanation: Surface area of a sphere = 4πr², volume = (4/3)πr³. Curved surface area of a hemisphere = 2πr², total surface area = 3πr², volume = (2/3)πr³.
importantPoints: Hemisphere does not have exactly half the volume formulas due to the flat surface addition

definitionBean.title: Frustum of a Cone
definitionBean.definition: When a cone is cut parallel to its base, the portion remaining between the apex and the cut part is called a frustum.
definitionBean.explanation: A frustum has two different radii r1 (top) and r2 (bottom). Its volume = (⅓)πh(r1²+r2²+r1r2), and curved surface area = πl(r1+r2), where l is the slant height.
importantPoints: Frustum is the solid obtained by cutting a cone parallelly

parts.statement: Two cubes each of volume 64 cm³ are joined end to end. Find the surface area of the resulting cuboid.
parts.explanation:
Given: Volume of each cube = 64 cm³
Let the side of the cube be a
a³ = 64 => a = 4 cm

When two such cubes are joined together, a cuboid is formed whose dimensions will be:
Length (l) = 4 + 4 = 8 cm
Breadth (b) = 4 cm
Height (h) = 4 cm

Total surface area of cuboid = 2(lb + bh + hl)
= 2(8×4 + 4×4 + 4×8)
= 2(32 + 16 + 32)
= 2(80) = 160 cm²
Therefore, the surface area of the resulting cuboid is 160 cm².

parts.statement: A toy is in the form of a cone of radius 3.5 cm mounted on a hemisphere of same radius. The total height of the toy is 15.5 cm. Find the total surface area of the toy. (Use π = 22/7)
parts.explanation:
Given:
Total height of toy = 15.5 cm
Radius of hemisphere (r) = 3.5 cm
Height of cone (h) = Total height - Radius of hemisphere = 15.5 - 3.5 = 12 cm

Slant height of cone (l):
l = √(r² + h²) = √( (3.5)² + 12² ) = √(12.25 + 144) = √156.25 = 12.5 cm

Total surface area of toy = CSA of cone + CSA of hemisphere
= πrl + 2πr²
= πr(l + 2r)
= (22 / 7) × 3.5 × (12.5 + 2 × 3.5)
= (22 / 7) × (7 / 2) × (12.5 + 7)
= 11 × 19.5
= 214.5 cm²
Therefore, the total surface area of the toy is 214.5 cm².

parts.statement: A medicine capsule is in the shape of a cylinder with two hemispheres stuck to each of its ends. The length of the entire capsule is 14 mm and the diameter of the capsule is 5 mm. Find its surface area.
parts.explanation:
Given:
Total length of capsule = 14 mm
Diameter = 5 mm, so radius (r) = 5/2 = 2.5 mm

Length of cylindrical part (h) = Total length - (Radius of hemisphere + Radius of hemisphere)
h = 14 - (2.5 + 2.5) = 14 - 5 = 9 mm

Surface area of capsule = CSA of cylinder + 2 × (CSA of hemisphere)
= 2πrh + 2(2πr²)
= 2πr(h + 2r)
= 2 × (22 / 7) × 2.5 × (9 + 2 × 2.5)
= (44 / 7) × 2.5 × (9 + 5)
= (44 / 7) × 2.5 × 14
= 44 × 2.5 × 2
= 44 × 5 = 220 mm²
Therefore, the surface area of the capsule is 220 mm².

parts.statement: From a solid cylinder of height 2.4 cm and diameter 1.4 cm, a conical cavity of the same height and same diameter is hollowed out. Find the total surface area of the remaining solid to the nearest cm².
parts.explanation:
Given:
Height of cylinder (h) = 2.4 cm
Diameter of cylinder = 1.4 cm, so radius (r) = 0.7 cm
Height and radius of cone are equal to that of cylinder.

Slant height of cone (l):
l = √(r² + h²) = √((0.7)² + (2.4)²) = √(0.49 + 5.76) = √6.25 = 2.5 cm

Total surface area of remaining solid = CSA of cylinder + Area of base of cylinder + CSA of cone
= 2πrh + πr² + πrl
= πr(2h + r + l)
= (22 / 7) × 0.7 × (2(2.4) + 0.7 + 2.5)
= 22 × 0.1 × (4.8 + 3.2)
= 2.2 × 8
= 17.6 cm² (approx 18 cm²)
Therefore, the surface area of the remaining solid is approx 18 cm².
